div.h1: Cloud Run Egress Architecture — Backend / Exporter / Autolayout / Fetcher

ul.li: Source = Backend SA → allow broader HTTPS (still block RFC1918/link-local)
Source = Fetcher SA (optional) → general web allow with deny lists
Allow → SWP VIP:80,443 (for tags: egress-web, egress-sentry, egress-fetcher)
